http_api: optional human QA and evidence only; no task intake
identity_source: operator-owned policy loaded by the separate MCP process; never an MCP argument
repository_scope: operator-owned allowlist of already registered local Git mirrors
read_access: registered local Git base and PR head commits
registered approved specification and fixed test profile
the authorized run's checksummed evidence manifest and allowlisted UTF-8 artifacts
write_access: operator-configured RunManager data directory: immutable snapshots, disposable workspaces, run state and evidence

execution.docker_image: operator-pinned SHA-256 digest; no image pulls
execution.local_trusted: operator opt-in for reviewed fixtures only; host execution is not network-isolated
execution.budgets: Pydantic request ceilings intersect with the stricter operator policy
execution.model_repair: no provider by default; explicit operator injection and budget required

test_artifact: manifest-allowlisted UTF-8 evidence up to the operator byte cap

forbidden_actions: unregistered repository or model-selected repository path
model-supplied role, approval, test command, runner backend or policy
GitHub write, merge, deployment or automatic QA approval
untrusted host execution, external network access from the Docker runner
artifact path traversal or access outside the manifest
deployment_requirement: Run the MCP process with operator-controlled policy and data ACLs separate from the model-writable Prime Python kernel. Prime's kernel is not a security sandbox.
